scope.runtime: Linux x86_64 standalone C host / streamed Native C engine
scope.operation: WLD open and full circuit compile to ready; public reference additionally initializes the 64 x 48 monochrome display
scope.cache_caveat: OS page cache was uncontrolled. Fresh-process runs are not verified cold-storage measurements.

provenance.optimization: Sparse wired-row and gate compiler indexes, skipped absent wire colors, bulk-zero output arrays, checked inline decode and paged-word access. Column/color/row ordering preserved; no persistent compiled cache.
provenance.artifact_boundary: These numbers bind to the isolated optimized library above. Final merged Native/WASM artifacts differ and have not been certified by these measurements.

input.origin: Public upstream Computerraria WLD; world bytes are not included

public_reference_world.peak_rss_interpretation: The measured gain is loading time. Peak process RSS was effectively unchanged; no memory reduction is claimed.

validation.isolated_off_mode_cpu_48_signatures_and_: passed; original isolated acceptance snapshot, before the new PixelBox-rule assertions

separate_dart_owner_observation.scope: Dart owner import with the isolated loading variant; distinct from standalone C load timing and not a Flutter UI measurement

sanitized_private_world.measurement_scope: standalone C streamed world open plus full circuit compile to ready; excludes ordinary UI preview and rendering; excludes input hashing
sanitized_private_world.redaction: Only dimensions, format version, byte count and aggregate/run timing results are public. Private input name, path, hash and source bytes are omitted.

current_pure_wld_acceptance.off: Physical CPU works. Ordinary PixelBoxes require both axes in the same game-rule TripWire, so this WLD does not display Pong in OFF mode.
current_pure_wld_acceptance.on: WireHead-style group-pair parity within a logic-gate wave drives the actual 3072 monochrome PixelBoxes. This changes future pixel behavior; it is not merely a speed switch.
current_pure_wld_acceptance.final_merged_native_acceptance: passed; one fresh local process per mode; see pure-wld-backend-acceptance-2026-10-09.json
current_pure_wld_acceptance.historical_companion_format_evidence: CPU/Pong, browser, continuation and soak results from the former multi-file format do not certify this candidate.
current_pure_wld_acceptance.on_no_reset_saved_continuation: passed under final Node WASM; see pure-wld-backend-acceptance-2026-10-09.json

limitations: Three runs per variant and world are bounded host-local evidence, not a hardware-independent speed guarantee.
Standalone C load timings and the separate Dart owner observation must not be substituted for actual Flutter UI import timing.
Tracked allocation release does not prove immediate process RSS return or absence of a leak.
The unchanged historical baseline report remains the source for its sampling and closed-RSS observations.
No private save, private source identifier, credential or proprietary game source is included.
